blocks.text: The order was clear and blunt. “Henceforth and with utmost urgency,” the Supreme Court said in its landmark ruling handed down Aug. 26 and released Sept. 16, the Congress of the Philippines must “enact the appropriate anti-political dynasty law at the earliest opportunity.” In the 86-page decision penned by Associate Justice Ramon Paul Hernando, the […]...
